card.name: Ends of product and ingredient names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug or product name, or a dosage-form word such as powder, in administration instructions. It fires on the final part of names like talc, BELBUCA, CERVIDIL and anhydrase, just before the sentence moves on.

card.writes: It promotes dry-form and object words such as powder, sock and rollers, and suppresses liquid words.
card.plain: It marks the end of a drug name, especially for dry products like powders, and steers away from liquid words.
